Na,.g: na dūre ṭhitehi rajakādisaddā cirena sotaviññāṇena suyyanti, sace savanūpacāre so saddo dūre āsanne ca ṭhitānaṁ yathābhūte āpāthagate sadde manoviññāṇasaṅkhātato gahaṇavisesato cirena suto sīghaṁ sutoti abhimānoti attho.

na,.g: Tattha yathā cetopariyañāṇalābhino eva ariyā paresaṁ lokuttaracittaṁ jānanti, tatthāpi ca arahā eva sabbesaṁ, na sabbe, evaṁ nibbānampi sīlasamādhipaññāsaṅkhātasammāpaṭipattibhūtena upāyena upalabbhatīti atthavacanaṁ cetaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, na payogavacanaṁ.
